title: fix(workspace-manifest-writer): match existing quote style in pnpm-workspace.yaml for exclude entries (pnpm/pnpm#15079)
body: ## Summary When writing exclude entries (for `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` and `trustPolicyExclude`) to `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, pnpm v12 previously always formatted quoted entries with single quotes (e.g. `- '@scope/pkg@1.0.0'`). If the manifest uses double quotes for string scalars, code formatters (such as Prettier or Oxfmt) reformat single quotes to double quotes on formatting passes, resulting in file churn on every install. This change scans string scalars in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` to detect whether double quotes are dominant. When double quotes are dominant, new quoted exclude entries are formatted with double quotes. When single quotes are dominant, or when quote counts are equal or absent, it falls back to single quotes. Plain-safe scalars remain unquoted, and existing exclude entries are preserved verbatim. Closes pnpm/pnpm#15079 ## Squash Commit Body ```text Detect the dominant quote style of string scalars in pnpm-workspace.yaml when writing or updating exclude entries (minimumReleaseAgeExclude and trustPolicyExclude). If double quotes are dominant, format new quoted exclude entries with double quotes to avoid churn with formatters such as Prettier or Oxfmt. Fall back to single quotes if single quotes dominate or if counts are equal or absent. Closes pnpm/pnpm#15079 ``` ## Checklist - [x] I checked the referenced issue and verified that none of the PRs already linked to it solves it. - [x] New features are implemented only in the Rust pnpm v12 CLI. Bug fixes are implemented in every affected version. - [x] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this PR changes any published package. Keep it short and written for pnpm users — it becomes a release note. - [x] Added or updated tests. -------- Signed by Antigravity (Gemini) --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. Autofix is disabled. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * New entries written to `pnpm-workspace.yaml` now follow the file’s dominant quote style, including in flow-style lists. Existing entries and unrelated settings remain preserved. When the file has mixed or no quoted values, new entries use single quotes when quoting is needed.
